title: Plan: new platform features
blurb: All 678 features that chromestatus.com lists for Chrome 130 to 160, each with a note on how it could be used with a canvas that draws live DOM, and a ranked list of 28 demos to build.
question: Which features from Chrome 130 to 160 can be combined with a canvas that draws live DOM, and which demos should be built from them?
result: 359 of 678 features have an idea, 44 are measured, and 28 demos are planned.
